title: DashboardModule
description: Standard output contract for every Autonoma agent. Each agent produces this after a successful run. API aggregates these into the dashboard response. Field 'stale' is NOT stored - computed by API at read time from last_successful_run + stale_after_seconds per source.

summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary in client's language

last_successful_run.description: Timestamp of the last successful agent run

sources.description: Per-source freshness tracking. Keys are source names (e.g. 'reviews', 'performance', 'profile'). API computes stale per source.

stale_after_seconds.description: 2x normal interval. E.g. weekly source = 1209600 (14 days), daily = 172800 (2 days)

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the module data quality

metrics.description: Agent-specific key metrics. Schema varies per module.

top_issue.description: Single most important issue, or null if none
